annotations.title: Check whether ChatGPT recommends a business

description: Asks ChatGPT up to three questions a potential customer would ask, and reports for each whether the business was named or its site linked, and which businesses were named instead. Also checks whether AI tools can read the site. Write the questions yourself: short, like a real customer, naming the city or country when known, and never naming the business; ask the person what the business sells and where if you don't know. Takes up to a minute. Two checks per website per day. Free.

business_name.description: The business's name, if you know it.

country.description: Two-letter code of the main country the business serves, for example AE, AU, GB or US. Used for search rankings and ChatGPT's answers.

questions.description: Up to three questions a customer would ask an AI assistant, for example 'Who are the best commercial cleaners in Dubai?'

website.description: The website address, for example yourcompany.com.

name: check_ai_visibility
